name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo Flores' journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After earning his degree in Human Resources from ITESM, he initially worked in the manufacturing sector. However, his passion for racing, ignited by watching Formula 1 with his father, never waned. A chance encounter with a Meyer Shank Racing engineer at a local car meet led to an internship, which quickly evolved into a full-time position within their HR department.

Ricardo believes in fostering a high-performance culture through rigorous yet fair employee evaluations and development programs. He's known for his data-driven approach to talent acquisition and retention, always seeking to identify and cultivate the next generation of motorsport professionals. Ricardo is also a staunch advocate for diversity and inclusion within the team, believing that a variety of perspectives is crucial for innovation.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to the well-being of the team. He understands the pressures of the motorsport world and actively promotes work-life balance initiatives. He’s created a mentorship program pairing senior and junior staff, and he is always available to lend an ear to anyone dealing with personal or professional challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo has a strong build and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized desk with color-coded files.
Drinks yerba mate throughout the day.
Starts every meeting with a motivational quote from a famous racer.
